Pri (CS): Heads-up 1 trial/onboard tenants in EU reported stale search results this AM. Opening thread to coordinate comms, RCA, and renewal mitigation.

Arun (SRE): Investigating. Early signal: backfill worker pool shrank after a config reload; queue grew and some jobs expired.

Lea (Eng): Root cause: a recent deploy shipped a config that set `backfill_concurrency=1` for the rewriter in eu clusters. Canary missed it due to low traffic. Impact window ~04:1004:32 UTC.

Jamal (Support): Affected tickets: ONB-930, ONB-936, ONB-940. Customers asking if vectors are recoverable and whether this affects demos/renewals.

Arun (SRE): No data loss  expired jobs were regenerated from source and backfilled after rollback at 04:35 UTC. Backfill completed by 04:50 UTC for known tenants.

Pri (CS): Comms plan: 1) send short status update to affected tickets now; 2) prepare tailored exec RCA for renewal-risk accounts with timeline + mitigations; 3) offer compensation: renewal-risk -> 2-week extension + ops review; others -> 72h extension.

Lea (Eng): Prevention items for RCA: add a config lint to catch low-concurrency values, add a deploy smoke that writes+reads a synthetic embed, and gate future changes if backfill queue > threshold.

Arun (SRE): Added alert rule and rollback executed. I'll attach backfill job IDs to tickets and confirm freshness metrics.

Jamal (Support): Sending short status now: "We've identified and resolved an issue that delayed embedding updates; rollback applied; backfill complete; no data lost. We'll follow up with a detailed summary for impacted accounts."

Pri (CS): Thanks all. I'll draft the exec email and office-hour invites and paste them here for quick review before sending at 11:00 UTC. Please flag edits by 10:45. :pray:
